_readme: Category landing pages built by tools/build_card_pages.py. A page is only published when at least 'min_in_stock' unsold cards match it, so there are never empty or thin pages; it appears or disappears automatically as stock changes. Placeholders: {count} cards in stock, {grade_range} e.g. 'PSA 8 to PSA 10', {grades} e.g. 'PSA 9 & PSA 10', {languages} e.g. 'Japanese and English', {sets} up to four set names in stock, {era} / {era_summary} (era pages), {pokemon} (Pokémon pages), {guide_link} a link to the set guide. Keep copy factual and readable: one clear keyword phrase per page, no repetition for its own sake.

fixed.title: PSA Graded Pokémon Cards for Sale UK | Graded Cards 01
fixed.h1: PSA Graded Pokémon Cards for Sale
fixed.description: Buy PSA graded Pokémon cards in the UK: {count} slabs from {grade_range}, {languages}. Every cert can be checked on PSA's website. Tracked, sealed delivery.
about: PSA (Professional Sports Authenticator) is the most widely used grading company for Pokémon cards. Each card is graded on a 1 to 10 scale and sealed in a tamper-evident case with its own certification number.
You can look up any cert on PSA's website before you buy, and if a cert ever fails to verify we'll refund you in full. Every order ships from the UK, tracked and signed-for, under a numbered seal.
